messages.text: Very lonely in the support queue waiting for an update on my support request email from 17th Sept. Feels like I have been ghosted or stood up at the movies by a date. At least the movies is only the cost of the bus home and not an entire mining rig that can’t be used.
Handed to the team · A month of holding replies, no decision made; customer needs an outcome, not ano

Simon, you're right to be annoyed. Raised 17 September, chased on the 9th, 12th and 15th, and still no decision on a unit you can't safely leave running. That's a month of holding replies from us.

I've put it to Georges and JD as a decision to make today, not another check: either a UK-safe supply for the BS-2, or the return approved with a replacement or credit.

Stay in the chat and one of them will come in here. If you step away, the answer reaches you by email.

Not even had any replies after the initial one despite chasers for an update of some description.  I know I can go onto Discord but despite the poor service I don’t want to air it in public and potentially adversely effect the business

That's decent of you, Simon, and you shouldn't have to go public to get an answer. Discord isn't needed here.

It's with Georges and JD now as a decision, flagged this afternoon, and the answer comes back in this chat or to (email hidden) Worth whitelisting (email hidden) and (email hidden), as some of our mail has been landing in junk.

If nothing has reached you, come straight back here and I'll push it again rather than let it sit.
